metadata.title: Mohammed Bilal P S | Quantum Control Research
metadata.description: Portfolio of Mohammed Bilal P S — PhD researcher in quantum control, robust optimization, and machine learning for quantum systems.

hero.description: A good part of my research is, in essence, quantum babysitting: using optimal control to gently steer quantum systems, and robust control to keep things on track when they become predictably uncooperative.

focus: Pontryagin and gradient-based methods for robust, energy-efficient quantum control
RL and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) as control tools for quantum systems

contact.title: Let's Discuss Quantum Control & Computation
contact.description: I'm always open to discussing quantum control, machine learning applications in physics, or potential collaborations.
